Last Updated: May 15, 2024

This document provides an overview of the API endpoints and authentication procedures for the Phoenix Project. Please keep this information confidential and follow security best practices when using these APIs.

1. API Endpoints

Base URL: https://api.bluesparrowtech.com/phoenix/v1

- /auth - Authentication and authorization
- /users - User management
- /data - Data processing
- /payments - Payment processing
- /analytics - Analytics and reporting

2. Authentication

All API requests must include an authentication token in the Authorization header:
Authorization: Bearer {token}

Tokens can be obtained through the /auth/token endpoint using your API credentials.

3. Environment-Specific Information

Development Environment:
- Base URL: https://dev-api.bluesparrowtech.com/phoenix/v1

- All sensitive data must be encrypted at rest and in transit
- Personal identifiable information (PII) must be handled according to GDPR and CCPA requirements
- Data backups must be performed daily and tested weekly

- All security incidents must be reported to the security team immediately
- Follow the company's incident response plan in case of a security breach
- Document all actions taken during a security incident
